title: Reading Drill — Finding Suitable Public Noticeboards
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Finding Suitable Public Noticeboards
passages.body:
**A** A small town chose sites for public noticeboards after speaking to groups that announced events. The expected cost of a board mattered, but the council also counted the number of people walking past each possible site.

**B** One location beside the post office was busy at lunchtime, but cyclists could not stop without blocking a narrow cycle lane. Organisers moved the board to a wall beside a wider pavement.

**C** After installation, members of the library removed notices with past dates once a week. People could post for free as long as each item listed the event date, which made the checking manageable.
